question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The boy watched a sci-fi movie __in the lieu of playing__ in the game zone.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"in lieu of"** means instead of or in place of something. (के बजाय)

 
 
• **Example: **She offered to cook dinner** in lieu of paying **rent.
 
 
 
• **"Playing"** refers to engaging in an activity for enjoyment or recreation. (खेलना)
 
 
• **Example: **The children spent the afternoon **playing** in the park.
 
 

Hence, the correct phrase "in lieu of playing" means instead of engaging in the activity of playing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: in lieu off playing** (के बजाय): This is grammatically incorrect because **"off"** is a wrong preposition in this context.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: He went to the library in lieu off playing football.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: in lieu of play** (के बजाय): This is grammatically incorrect because** "play"** should be in its gerund form "playing" to fit the context.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: She chose to study in lieu of play.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: on lieu of playing** (के बजाय): This is grammatically incorrect because** "on" **is a wrong preposition in this context.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: He read a book on lieu of playing video games.
